title: Gold Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document explains Credit card APY bonuses for Gold Account holders at Rho-Bank, listing bonus amounts for each eligible card (e.g., EcoCard +0.6%, Diamond Elite Card +0.3%, Gold Rewards Card +0.025%, Crypto-Cash Back Card +0%). Bonuses apply automatically when the credit card and savings account are under the same customer profile, and Gold Rewards Card minimum balance is reduced from $10,000 to $5,000.
